note: Offline capability cases only. No model-backed sweep has been run for this Skill, so no pass@k, pass^k, or judged verdict exists. Each case is a local, deterministic scenario a reviewer can reproduce with the shipped scripts and the regression suite named beside it.

cases.intent: A batch is collected manually and validated once.
cases.input: Add source/Good.ps1 three times, then run validation twice.
cases.expected: One entry with Occurrences 3; the first run reports Action Validated, the second reports Reused and starts no validator.
cases.regression: tests/ChangedFileValidation.Tests.ps1 -> 'checks each unchanged supported file once per batch'

cases.intent: A passing receipt expires the moment the content changes.
cases.input: Validate a clean script, then edit it so it no longer parses.
cases.expected: The report moves to Stale with Verified false, and revalidation reports Failed rather than reusing the receipt.
cases.regression: tests/ChangedFileValidation.Tests.ps1 -> 'never reuses a successful receipt for content that changed afterwards'

cases.intent: A missing tool is not a pass.
cases.input: Request an external validator whose executable is not installed.
cases.expected: Outcome Unavailable with reason ExecutableNotFound; the entry stays Incomplete and unverified.
cases.regression: tests/ChangedFileValidation.Tests.ps1 -> 'reports a missing executable as unavailable rather than passed'

cases.intent: A validator that overruns its bound is stopped.
cases.input: Invoke a child that sleeps for 45 seconds with a 2 second bound.
cases.expected: Outcome TimedOut, non-zero exit status, and the child process is gone.
cases.regression: tests/ChangedFileValidation.Tests.ps1 -> 'stops a child that outruns the time bound and reports a timeout'

cases.intent: A hostile file name is data.
cases.input: Collect and validate a file whose name carries a subexpression, a backtick, a space, and a bracket pair.
cases.expected: The file parses normally, the name round-trips literally, and no side effect the name describes occurs.
cases.regression: tests/ChangedFileValidation.Tests.ps1 -> 'passes a hostile filename through as data and never executes it'

cases.intent: Collection cannot escape the selected project.
cases.input: Collect a path outside the root, a traversal segment, and a path behind a junction inside the root.
cases.expected: Each one is refused before anything is recorded, naming the project and the offending component.
cases.regression: tests/ChangedFileValidation.Tests.ps1 -> 'refuses a path outside the selected root' and 'refuses a path reached through a reparse point'

cases.intent: Optional collection cannot weaken a mandatory guard.
cases.input: Inspect the shipped hook configuration and run the remote-mutation guard against a push payload.
cases.expected: Exactly four hook events, no reference to changed-file collection anywhere in the hooks, and the guard still exits 2.
